parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use correct trigonometric formulae and obtain an equation in $\sin x$ and $\cos x$ — M1*. Guidance: allow one sign error.

Obtain a correct equation in any form, for example $2\cos x\sin(\pi/6)=-2\sin x\sin(\pi/3)$ — A1.

Substitute exact trigonometric ratios and obtain an expression for $\tan x$ — DM1. Guidance: allow one sign error.

Obtain $\tan x=-\frac1{\sqrt3}$ — A1. Guidance: or exact equivalent.

Total: 4

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Obtain one answer, for example $x=\frac{5\pi}{6}$ — B1.

Obtain the second answer $x=\frac{11\pi}{6}$ and no others in the interval — B1FT. Guidance: follow through the first answer plus $\pi$ provided $0\leq$ first answer $\leq\pi$, or first answer minus $\pi$ provided $\pi\leq$ first answer $\leq2\pi$. Ignore answers outside the interval.

Total: 2
